summary: You approve held policy changes once, in one place, and the approval holds.

new.title: Approve all held policy changes
new.text: The Approvals page lists every held policy change for groups, Entra roles and Azure roles, with one Approve all button. The policy jobs start straight after.

fixes.title: An approval sticks
fixes.text: An approval used to expire as soon as anything new appeared. It now covers later runs unless they weaken something you have not approved.

fixes.title: Clearer approval screens
fixes.text: Approved changes show as applying on the next run, and each weakening policy is listed with its change in plain words.

fixes.title: Admin names checked without case
fixes.text: Admin names now match your naming convention regardless of upper or lower case, and the warning shows the expected name.
